comments.body: Hi, may I ask you how do you register for the entrance exam? Right now I am doing an Elektroniker Lehre  with BM, my grades are pretty good (Average 5.9 in Lehre and 5.1 in BMS) and I would like to study Electrical Eng. / Information Technology, but I can't find any information on how to register for the entrance exam. And what exactly determines whether you have to take the reduced or the extended entrance exam?
comments.author: Infinite-Chemist-747
